name: Palestine
people: Where Palestinians and Co-designers design the nation they want to live in.
codesigner: Everyone who shares a vision, a voice or an enterprise here becomes a Co-designer of Perfect Palestine: one of a community of selfless people, at home and abroad, building a nation where every citizen has a decent life.

paras: Nine in ten of your young people complete lower secondary school, and your olive groves cover most of your land. A third of you live below the national poverty line, and the needs of reconstruction are counted in tens of billions. Let the rebuilding be financed so that it lasts, and owned by those who live in it.
letter.quote: “An educated generation is the first asset. Let the rebuilding be theirs.”

mandates.terms: For the Palestinian Authority, its development partners and investors. Scope and fees are agreed in writing before any work begins.

capita.pc_text: The yearly cost, per person, of lifting everyone above the Living Line in all seven basic living standards, set with Palestine in its own prices.
capita.price_text: Perfect Capita times the population: the national bill, each year.
capita.est: Perfect Nations estimate, to be confirmed with Palestine. Figures marked dated rest on surveys more than five years old; lenient measures are marked as such.
capita.measures: Strict measures. Food: share not moderately or severely food insecure (FAO). Water: safely managed drinking water where measured; where it is not, basic water, marked as such. Shelter: the lower of safely managed sanitation and the share outside urban slums. Energy: the lower of electricity per person against 1,000 kWh and clean cooking; where electricity per person is not published, clean cooking. Education: the lower of children reading by the end of primary school and lower-secondary completion. Health: WHO service coverage index. Livelihood: share above the stricter of the national poverty line and the World Bank line for the nation’s income group (US$8.30 a day for high-income nations). Each figure links to its source. For Palestine, the delivery test (12 November 2026): Energy takes the lower of these and the share of national demand the grid actually serves, from OCHA and PCBS.

voices.local: We are looking for the people with real stories from Palestine: the leaders who built something that works, and the keepers of local knowledge who know how their communities live, cope and thrive.

close_lead: Share your vision, suggest a guest, or write to us. Every message receives a personal reply.
sources: World Bank, World Development Indicators (API), accessed 10 November 2026: population and ages 0 to 14, 2025; land area and agricultural and forest land; renewable fresh water per person, 2022; natural resource, oil, gas and mineral rents, 2021; renewable electricity output, 2021; tourism receipts; personal remittances; electricity access and clean cooking.

The seven standards: FAO food insecurity, WHO/UNICEF JMP water and sanitation, UN-Habitat urban slums, World Bank clean cooking, learning poverty and lower-secondary completion, and poverty headcounts (all via the World Bank); WHO UHC service coverage index, 2023.
IMF, World Economic Outlook, October 2026 (DataMapper, accessed 10 November 2026): general government gross debt, 2025, and real GDP growth projected for 2026.
World Bank press releases of 23 May 2024 and 18 February 2025; World Bank projects P504704 and P503036.
Electricity supplied against demand: OCHA and PCBS, 2026, read 12 November 2026.
